recognize_zh: 畫面中央是一顆大的巨噬細胞，細胞質豐富、淡藍色帶細纖維狀紋理，邊緣緊貼幾顆核濃縮深染、細胞質灰藍的紅血球前驅細胞（normoblast）；周圍混有各階段顆粒球前驅細胞，呈現正常骨髓中的紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Large central macrophage with abundant pale blue, finely fibrillar cytoplasm and an irregular, partly folded nucleus
Several erythroid precursors abutting the macrophage, with round nuclei, condensed chromatin and gray-blue to polychromatic cytoplasm
Numerous small erythroid precursors (polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts) scattered in the background with round, dense nuclei
Admixed granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes, bands) with pink granular cytoplasm showing orderly maturation
No blast excess, megaloblastic change or obvious dysplasia in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (Leishman stain, oil immersion) shows a cellular field with trilineage-appropriate precursors. A large central macrophage with abundant pale blue fibrillar cytoplasm is closely apposed by erythroid precursors showing progressive nuclear condensation and cytoplasmic hemoglobinization, forming an erythroblastic island; the ring of attached erythroblasts is incomplete in this plane of the smear. The surrounding granulocytic precursors mature in an orderly fashion, and no increase in blasts, megaloblastic change or dyserythropoiesis is identified. Findings are consistent with a normal erythroblastic island in bone marrow.

ddx.vs: A hemophagocytic histiocyte contains engulfed intact erythrocytes, nucleated cells or platelets within its cytoplasm, whereas island erythroblasts sit on the macrophage surface without being ingested.
Pseudo-Gaucher and sea-blue histiocytes occur in high-turnover states such as CML or ITP and are defined by the cytoplasmic storage material itself, not by a rosette of attached erythroblasts.
Tumor clumps are cohesive sheets of atypical non-hematopoietic cells with large pleomorphic nuclei, unlike a single benign macrophage surrounded by maturing normoblasts.
